newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denmark launches 10 bln yen 4.1% yen/A$ samurai.
newsitem.headline: Denmark launches 10 bln yen 4.1% yen/A$ samurai.

text.p: Denmark on Friday launched 10 billion yen worth of 4.1 percent yen/Australian dollar dual currency samurai bonds due on January 13, 2000, with special terms at maturity, lead manager Nikko Securities said.
The samurai bonds are priced at par, with twice yearly coupon payments.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars, under special terms.
The terms are that holders of the bonds will receive A$6,400.41 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity if the Australian dollar is below 78.12 yen on December 13, 1999.
But if the Aussie is at or above 78.12 yen by that time, then holders will receive the face value of each 500,000 yen bond at maturity.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows.
AMT 10 bln yen COUPON 4.1% MATURITY Jan 13, 2000
TYPE yen/A$ samurai PAY DATE Oct 14, 1996
ISS PRICE par SIGN DATE Sept 25, 1996
LEAD MANAGER Nikko Securities Co Ltd
LEAD TRUSTEE Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd
